🏹 ArrowDodge

Arrows fly in from all directions and you must dodge them. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Move your character to dodge arrows flying in from all sides.
  2. Watch for visual cues indicating arrow direction before they launch.
  3. The arrow frequency increases as waves progress.
  4. Stay near the center early to maximize reaction time.
  5. Arrow patterns become more complex in later waves.
